groundingWarnings.no_context: Nothing relevant was found in this project, so no answer was generated from its code.

preflight.needsReindexBody: It was indexed with a different embedding model, so its stored vectors cannot be searched with the one this instance runs now. Re-index it and questions will work again.
preflight.askToReindex: Ask the person who added it, or an administrator, to re-index.
preflight.notReadyTitle: This project is not ready yet
preflight.notReadyBody: It is still cloning or indexing. Questions work once it reaches “Ready”.
